PROVIDER PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT
This Provider Participation Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of July 5, 2023 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Lakeshore Health Insurance Co. ("Plan") and Westfield Cardiology Associates
("Provider").

ARTICLE I - TERM AND TERMINATION
1.1 Initial Term. This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of 4
years, expiring on July 4, 2027.
1.2 Renewal. This Agreement shall not renew automatically. Any extension beyond the initial term requires
a written amendment signed by both parties.
1.3 Termination Without Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon 180 days
prior written notice to the other party.

ARTICLE II - COMPENSATION
2.1 Inpatient Services. Plan shall reimburse Provider for covered acute medical/surgical inpatient services at
a per diem rate of $2,800 per day. Behavioral health inpatient services are reimbursed at $3,100 per day.
2.2 Outpatient Services. Plan shall reimburse Provider for covered general outpatient services at 155% of the
then-current Medicare fee schedule. Emergency department services are reimbursed at 145% of the
Medicare fee schedule.

ARTICLE III - CLAIMS
3.1 Payment of Clean Claims. Plan shall pay each clean claim within 15 days after receipt.
3.2 Timely Filing. Provider shall submit claims within 90 days after the date of service. Claim denials may
be appealed within 60 days of the denial notice.

ARTICLE IV - CREDENTIALING
4.1 Plan shall complete credentialing of Provider's practitioners within 90 days after receipt of a complete
application.

ARTICLE V - GENERAL PROVISIONS
5.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Michigan.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 10 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 30 days before pursuing other remedies.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
